strings.msgid: One pass over one L2 DAK component: the agent edits it, runs its checker, renders and stages it with a before/after, and hands it on; review forks off beside the hand-on and never holds it up (adjudication is QA, not a gate). Called once per component pass by each authoring track of l2-dak-authoring.bpmn (Process_L2Dak). Only the call's inputs differ between components (skill l2-component-edit-review, "The inputs, per component"): - component: personas and user scenarios (C2, C3), business processes (C4), core data elements and glossary (C5) with their terminology bindings, decision-support and scheduling logic (C6, C7), indicators and requirements (C8, C9); - authoring skill: l2-dak-authoring, bpmn-authoring, dmn-authoring or terminology-management, named on the calling activity, so it joins this process's skills along the call path (review-task.bpmn's scoped composition); - renderer and diff: what the reviewer sees, before and after; - checker: the mechanical checks the agent runs before asking anyone; - reviewing role: the person who takes this process's reviewer lane for the call.
